decisions: Anomaly detection uses a per-topic robust median/MAD baseline rather than a mean/std baseline so one extreme value does not distort its own reference.
A zero MAD falls back to one absolute frequency unit, allowing outliers in otherwise constant count series to remain detectable.
Each AnomalyEvent preserves the period, frequency, baseline median, robust score, direction and normalized strength.
The detector is deterministic, local and dependency-free; adaptive or seasonal baselines are deferred.
risks: The fallback scale of one is a deliberate count-unit heuristic for constant series and may need domain calibration later.
Seasonality and calendar-aware baselines are not inferred by this task.
